# 💉 SysDexDump

A lightweight and powerful **DEX dumping tool** designed for Android reverse-engineering enthusiasts

## If you face any problem then contact me in telegram username - @aantik_mods

---

## How to Build

1. **Download AIDE Android IDE** 
2. Make sure you are using **NDK 64-bit**  
3. Open the project in AIDE and tap **Build Compile & Run**

That’s it your binary will be ready!

---

## Example Usage

```bash
./SysDumpDex com.hlw.app /data/local/tmp/OutDir
